blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY — A 15-year-old boy has admitted killing his 46-year-old mother with a hammer following an argument at their home in Panglao, Bohol, before dragging her body to an abandoned septic tank, police said Sunday, Nov. 1. Police Major Joseph Lopena, spokesperson for the Bohol Police Provincial Office (BPPO), said Panglao police initiated contact with the teenager, who eventually confessed to killing his mother. Investigators said the boy allegedly attacked his mother after she reprimanded him for cutting classes.
